name: goBILDA BIOBUZZ StarterBot (6WD drop-center)
notes: Values marked 'estimate' are NOT from goBILDA and must be replaced by measurements. Dimensions marked 'official CAD' were read from 3200-2627-0003.step.
Hardware names, motor directions, wheel diameter, track width and encoder resolutions come from goBILDA's official example code (3200-2627-0003_example-code).
Motor electrical constants are the commonly published 5203 Yellow Jacket figures and still need checking against the goBILDA product pages.
Inertias of the rotating parts, gear tooth counts, backlash and chain slack are in the assembly file under "drivetrain".

chassis.trackWidth_source: official CAD (matches TRACK_WIDTH_MM in the official example code)
chassis.wheelRadius_source: 96 mm nominal (official code WHEEL_DIAMETER_MM; CAD tread measures 95.9 mm)
chassis.frontAxleRise_source: official CAD: front omni axle is 2 mm above the rear and middle axles

tire.source: estimate: about 0.5 mm static tire deflection; omni rollers assumed nearly free sideways

massProperties.frame: +X left, +Y up, +Z front; origin at the centre of the middle axle
massProperties.source: estimate: official CAD part volumes x assumed material densities, with approximate fixed masses for motors, battery and servos
massProperties.missing: REV Control Hub (about 0.2 kg) and wiring are not in the CAD and are not included

chassis.interiorRestitution_source: estimate: a ball squeezed and guided inside the robot does not bounce off its surfaces
chassis.edgeRadius_source: estimate: plate and channel edges are treated as rounded by 1 mm (real edges are not knife-sharp and the ball is soft)

yellowjacket-1.note: stall torque derived by dividing the 19.2:1 figure by 19.2 (estimate)

left_drive.label: Left drive motor (30T gears to the rear axle, chain to the middle axle; the front omni rolls freely)

right_drive.label: Right drive motor (30T gears to the rear axle, chain to the middle axle; the front omni rolls freely)

launcher.label: Launcher flywheel (Hogback wheel on Hyper Hub), direct on the 1:1 motor

intake.label: Intake motor: 100T gear driving the 20T Gecko shaft

left_intake_servo.label: Left intake Gecko wheel (speed servo); free speed is an estimate
left_intake_servo.stallTorque_source: estimate (about 9 kg cm for the speed servo at 6 V; check the goBILDA product page)

right_intake_servo.label: Right intake Gecko wheel (speed servo); free speed is an estimate
right_intake_servo.stallTorque_source: estimate (about 9 kg cm for the speed servo at 6 V; check the goBILDA product page)

windmill.label: Windmill feeder (torque servo); free speed is an estimate
windmill.stallTorque_source: estimate (about 20 kg cm for the torque servo at 6 V; check the goBILDA product page)

imu.label: Control Hub IMU (the hub is not in the CAD; yaw, pitch and roll are those of the chassis, with no drift or noise)

sensorMounts_note: The StarterBot has no other sensors. To add one, give it an entry under devices, e.g. {"kind":"distance","mount":{"position":[0,0.05,0.26],"direction":[0,0,1]},"maxM":2,"label":"front distance sensor"} or {"kind":"color","mount":{"position":[0,0.03,0.05]},"rangeM":0.08}. Positions are in the robot frame (+X left, +Y up, +Z front, metres from the middle axle centre). Touch, digital and analog inputs are set by hand in the Hardware panel.
